title: Adjudication v1
description: Companion schema for spec/judge-record-family-v1.md section 6. The root schema validates an Adjudication record: a ruling, reached by a named basis, over one or two cited parties -- the two-party case is capsule-emit-mesh's twin adjudication (cites two halves, chain.relation: adjudicates); the one-party case is what evaluation-report/v1's per-case entries structurally match (same basis field names: model_id, prompt_digest, sampling). epistemic_type is fixed to adjudication -- a ruling on a matter that was disputed or required judgment.

Citation.description: spec/judge-record-family-v1.md section 0 -- every record in this family cites what it read by digest, with a citation_purpose stating why.

SamplingParams.description: Scalar call parameters only -- int, string, or bool, never float. Mirrors capsule-judge's JudgePin.sampling_params convention: a judge pin digest must be reproducible, and a float in the reproducible call shape invites drift from serialization alone.

Basis.description: The judgment-basis fields, identical in name and meaning wherever this family reuses them (spec/judge-record-family-v1.md section 6) -- evaluation-report/v1's Case.basis is this same $def.

contradicted_party.description: Which party the verdict contradicts. REQUIRED when verdict is contradicted, absent otherwise -- see allOf below. Mirrors mesh's 'contradicted:<owner_id>' verdict string, split into a fixed verdict token plus this field rather than colon-encoding a dynamic value inside an enum.

divergence_index.description: Exact decimal string, never a JSON float -- this repository's own canonicalization (agent_action_capsule.canonical.json_digest) rejects floats in digest-bearing content, and this family holds every quantity field to that discipline whether or not the specific field is itself digested (mirrors margin/margin_tau above).
